title.description: Browser tab title and link-preview title.

description.description: One sentence for search results and link previews.

tags.description: Small coloured pills above your name.

title.description: Shown under your name, e.g. "Product Manager".

items.description: One paragraph. Wrap words in **double asterisks** to make them bold.

highlights.description: Key highlights cards. An empty list hides the section.

tag.description: Small label above the title, e.g. "AI · ESG".

text.description: One or two sentences. Keep it brief, so the cards stay even.

facts.description: Small tiles at the top of the case study.

heading.description: Block heading, e.g. "Context", "What I did", "Outcome", "What I learned".

blocks.description: The sections of the case study, in order.

caseStudy.description: Optional. With a case study the card shows "Read case study"; without one it shows no link.

comingSoon.description: true shows "Coming soon" where "Read case study" would be, for a case study not written yet. Ignored when the card has a case study.

experience.description: Jobs, newest first. An empty list hides the section.

end.description: Last month, as "YYYY-MM". Use null for your current job ("Present").

about.description: One line about the company, shown in small grey text.

bullets.description: What you did. The first 3 show; the rest sit behind "+ N more".

featured.description: The full-width card at the top of Skills.

label.description: Heading of the full-width card, e.g. "Product Management".

icon.description: Icon for the card label. Default: "compass".

groups.description: Cards below the featured one, in order.

wide.description: true makes this card about twice as wide. Good for long lists.

certifications.description: With a file, "View ↗" opens it in a pop-up. With only a url, it opens that page in a new tab. With neither, there is no "View".

file.description: A file in this content folder's files/ subfolder, e.g. "my-certificate.png". Images display better on phones than PDFs.

url.description: Optional web page for this certificate, e.g. a LinkedIn Learning certificate link. Used when there is no file; if both are set, the file wins.

languages.description: Languages you speak. An empty list hides the section.

tests.description: Test results, shown as chips on the right. With a file, the chip opens it in a pop-up; with only a url, it opens that page in a new tab.

file.description: A file in this content folder's files/ subfolder, e.g. "my-certificate.png". Images display better on phones than PDFs.

url.description: Optional web page for this certificate, e.g. a LinkedIn Learning certificate link. Used when there is no file; if both are set, the file wins.

projects.description: Vibe projects. An empty list hides the section.

text.description: One or two sentences on what it does and how it was built.

github.description: The project's GitHub address. Optional: without it there is no GitHub button.

link.description: Optional second button, next to GitHub.

interests.description: Personal interests. An empty list hides the section.

icon.description: Icon in the small round badge.

contact.description: The Contact section. Email, LinkedIn and GitHub come from site.json.

question.description: A line inviting people to get in touch.

workStatus.description: Your right to work, e.g. "EU citizen" or "Open to relocation".

name.description: Name shown in the AI panel header, e.g. "Jane's AI".

subtitle.description: Line under the name, e.g. "Answers as Jane, grounded in her resume".

greeting.description: First message the visitor sees in the chat.

items.description: A suggested question the visitor can click.

limitsNote.description: Optional. Your own line in the panel's note about wait times, after the general explanation, e.g. "This site runs on a free AI plan, which allows about two questions a minute." Leave it out if you have nothing to add.

title: en.json / sv.json: all page text in one language
